Induction Corridor.name: Induction Corridor
Induction Corridor.description: The user links every lamppost, rail, pipe, car and wire along a city block into one electromagnetic corridor for the rest of the scene. On command it accelerates bearings into volleys or slams metal-armored enemies into walls for heavy force and electric damage, pinning them until they wrench free with a hard effort; held back, it only knocks targets down and disarms steel weapons. Running both natures across a block fries every phone, camera and battery there and slows the user to a walk while it lasts. Strain: severe.
